bools.name: dliQualityLightFlexible

bools.comment: the possession save failure - the lifeforce successfully possessing the character (print capture p. 291)

bools.comment: the possession symptom - the character refusing to abandon or remove the armor (print capture p. 291)

bools.comment: the possession aftermath - the destroyed influence leaving the armor without all its magical properties (print capture p. 291)

bools.comment: the healing appearance - the armor appearing to be normal magical armor (print capture p. 291)

bools.name: dliHealingOncePerDayAutomatic
bools.comment: the healing trigger - once per day, automatically, whether desired or not, without warning or set time (print capture p. 291)

bools.comment: the healing cost - each healing taking one charge (print capture p. 291)

bools.comment: the healing exhaustion - all charges spent, the armor becoming +1 magical armor (print capture p. 291)
